root_motivation: The brain's tier ladder has no cheap reachability + auth probe: it discovers dead tiers by attempting them (incurring latency, billing, and auth errors). keel-pulse adds a zero-cost, non-generating health check — and the shared types every future keel/* subcommand extends — so any code or human can get a one-glance ladder health table without ever dispatching a completion.
user_persona: Joe Yen running wintermute on an Arch laptop where wm-brain's tier ladder silently degrades on misconfigured cloud tiers; also the /self-review automation that re-derives cloud reachability by hand every run.

acceptance_criteria.description: cargo build and cargo test succeed offline (no live network). A test asserts the probe path makes zero real outbound connections (FakeProbe only).
acceptance_criteria.test: tests/acceptance_ac1.rs: builds offline; FakeProbe records no real connect calls.

acceptance_criteria.description: TierStatus, TierHealth, LedgerEntry, Ladder, TierConfig are public and serde-(de)serializable; a round-trip test covers each.
acceptance_criteria.test: tests/acceptance_ac2.rs: serde round-trip for all five core types.

acceptance_criteria.description: keel pulse --format json emits one TierHealth per configured tier; with WM_BRAIN_SKIP_TIERS=local-8b set (via ProbeEnv fixture) that tier appears with status Skipped and is not probed.
acceptance_criteria.test: tests/acceptance_ac3.rs: JSON output has exactly the configured tiers; skipped tier present with status=Skipped.

acceptance_criteria.description: A cloud TierConfig with no key (empty WM_ANTHROPIC_KEY) yields status Keyless without the probe opening a socket (FakeProbe records no connect attempt for that tier).
acceptance_criteria.test: tests/acceptance_ac4.rs: keyless tier → Keyless status, FakeProbe connect_count == 0 for that tier.

acceptance_criteria.description: A local TierConfig whose endpoint refuses connection yields Unreachable{reason}; a reachable one yields Reachable. The probe uses a non-generating endpoint (FakeProbe sees /v1/models-class path, never /v1/chat/completions).
acceptance_criteria.test: tests/acceptance_ac5.rs: refused → Unreachable; reachable → Reachable; path checked is /v1/models not /v1/chat/completions.

acceptance_criteria.description: keel pulse exits non-zero when the top configured tier is not Reachable, zero otherwise; covered by two integration cases.
acceptance_criteria.test: tests/acceptance_ac6.rs: exit code 0 when top=Reachable, exit code 1 when top=Unreachable/Keyless.

acceptance_criteria.description: keel pulse | head -1 does not panic (SIGPIPE reset verified by a test that closes the read end early).
acceptance_criteria.test: tests/acceptance_ac7.rs: process survives early pipe close — no SIGPIPE panic.

acceptance_criteria.description: README documents the type surface and the TierProbe/ProbeEnv traits so keel-ledger/cordon/beacon have a contract to extend.
acceptance_criteria.test: tests/acceptance_ac8.rs: README.md exists and contains TierProbe, ProbeEnv, TierHealth, LedgerEntry, Ladder.

scope: New cargo workspace at ~/wintermute/keel with a keel binary crate
Core shared types: TierStatus enum, TierHealth struct, LedgerEntry struct, Ladder struct, TierConfig struct
TierProbe trait: fn probe(&self, tier: &TierConfig) -> TierHealth
ProbeEnv trait: reads WM_ANTHROPIC_KEY, WM_BRAIN_SKIP_TIERS, WM_BRAIN_MAX_TIER, endpoint URLs from env/config
FakeProbe and FakeProbeEnv test doubles (in tests/ or #[cfg(test)])
keel pulse subcommand: prints table of tier|status|checked|fails
keel pulse --format json: machine-readable JSON output
Exit code: 0 if top tier Reachable, non-zero otherwise
SIGPIPE safety via sigpipe::reset() in main()
README with type surface contract for sibling crates
non_goals: No actual completion requests or token generation — the probe never hits /v1/chat/completions
No writing or reading LedgerEntry data (keel-ledger PRD owns that); LedgerEntry is declared here but not persisted
No modifying the brain's runtime ladder — read-only config inspection only
No network probing in the default test suite — FakeProbe only, zero real network
No integration with agorabus or any other wintermute bus — standalone CLI only
No authentication token refresh or key rotation — Keyless detection only

additional.sigpipe_reset: true — sigpipe::reset() must be first line of main()
additional.no_real_network_in_tests: true — FakeProbe only; cargo test must pass offline

five_whys_trace.q: Why do you need a health probe for the brain's tier ladder?
five_whys_trace.a: Because the ladder discovers dead tiers by attempting them — paying latency and potential billing — rather than checking upfront.

five_whys_trace.q: Why does discovery-by-attempt cause real pain?
five_whys_trace.a: docket wm-anthropic-key-empty has 6 runs and 8 reports since 2026-05-30; every self-review re-derives 'cloud tier unreachable' by hand because nothing computes it on demand.

five_whys_trace.q: Why does re-deriving it by hand matter — can't we just check once?
five_whys_trace.a: There is no shared type for the answer. Ladder, TierHealth, TierStatus don't exist as reusable types — every check is ad-hoc. sibling PRDs (keel-ledger, keel-cordon, keel-beacon) all need the same types and can't start without a corpus.

ambiguities_resolved.question: Should keel be a library crate or a binary crate?
ambiguities_resolved.resolution: Binary crate (cli) per PRD. Library surface is exposed via pub mod so siblings can rust-extend it.

ambiguities_resolved.question: What HTTP client for local probe?
ambiguities_resolved.resolution: ureq (sync, minimal) matching wm-local-llm's choice. Keeps dep count low and offline tests trivial.
